en.s: The Sack of Mecca occurred on 11 January 930, when the Qarmatians of Bahrayn sacked the Muslim holy city amidst the rituals of the Hajj pilgrimage. The Qarmatians, a radical Isma'ili sect established in Bahrayn since the turn of the 9th century, had previously attacked the caravans of Hajj pilgrims and even invaded and raided Iraq, the heartland of the Abbasid Caliphate, in 927–928.

zh.t: 麦加遭卡尔马特派洗劫
zh.s: 930年1月11日，巴林地区的卡尔马特派在朝觐仪式期间洗劫了伊斯兰教圣城麦加。卡尔马特派是自9世纪之交起在巴林地区活动的激进伊斯玛仪派组织，此前曾袭击朝觐商队，并于927年至928年侵入阿拔斯王朝腹地伊拉克。

en.t: Theodora Porphyrogenita becomes sole Byzantine ruler
en.s: Theodora Porphyrogenita became the sole ruler of the Byzantine Empire on 11 January 1055. She had previously shared imperial authority and was the final sovereign of the Macedonian dynasty.

zh.t: 狄奥多拉成为拜占庭帝国唯一统治者
zh.s: 1055年1月11日，狄奥多拉·波菲罗根妮塔成为拜占庭帝国唯一的统治者。她此前曾与他人共同掌握皇权，也是马其顿王朝最后一位君主。

en.t: Vladislaus II is crowned king of Bohemia
en.s: Vladislaus II, previously duke of Bohemia, was crowned king at Regensburg on 11 January 1158. His royal title was not hereditary.

zh.t: 波希米亚公爵弗拉迪斯拉夫二世加冕为王
zh.s: 1158年1月11日，原任波希米亚公爵的弗拉迪斯拉夫二世在雷根斯堡加冕为波希米亚国王。他的王位头衔并非世袭。

en.s: Local Mapuche-Huilliche forces defeated a Spanish army at the Bueno River in southern Chile on 11 January 1654.

zh.s: 1654年1月11日，智利南部的马普切—威利切原住民武装在布埃诺河击败了一支西班牙军队。

en.s: The Battle of Lahore was fought between Afghan forces of the Durrani Empire under Ahmad Shah Durrani and Mughal forces under Shah Nawaz on 11 January 1748. Zakriya Khan, the Mughal Governor of Lahore, died in 1745 and was succeeded by his son, Yahya Khan. Yahya Khan's governorship over Lahore was soon challenged by his brother, Shah Nawaz, who was the governor of Multan.

zh.s: 1748年1月11日，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼率领的杜兰尼帝国阿富汗军队，与沙阿·纳瓦兹指挥的莫卧儿军队在拉合尔交战。莫卧儿拉合尔总督扎卡里亚汗于1745年去世，其子叶海亚汗接任。叶海亚汗的统治很快遭到其兄弟、木尔坦总督沙阿·纳瓦兹挑战。

en.s: The Capture of Trincomalee on 11 January 1782 was the second major engagement between Great Britain and the Dutch East India Company in the East Indies after outbreak of the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War. After capturing Negapatam, the major Dutch outpost in India, a British force assaulted the Dutch-controlled port of Trincomalee on the eastern coast of Ceylon, and successfully stormed Fort Fredrick and Fort Ostenburg to gain control of the city and the port. In gaining control of the port, they also captured the vessels in the port at the time.

zh.s: 1782年1月11日，英国在东印度地区攻占荷兰东印度公司控制的亭可马里。这是第四次英荷战争爆发后，双方在当地的第二场重要战斗。英军先前已夺取荷兰在印度的主要据点讷格伯德姆，随后进攻锡兰东海岸的亭可马里港，成功攻下弗雷德里克堡和奥斯滕堡，控制城市及港口，也俘获了当时停泊港内的船只。

en.s: William Herschel discovered Titania and Oberon, two moons of Uranus, on 11 January 1787.

zh.t: 赫歇尔发现天卫三与天卫四
zh.s: 1787年1月11日，威廉·赫歇尔发现了天王星的两颗卫星——天卫三（Titania）和天卫四（Oberon）。

en.s: The 1803 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on January 11, 1803, in order to elect the first Governor of Ohio upon Ohio acquiring statehood on March 1, 1803. Democratic-Republican nominee and former Speaker of the Northwest Territory House of Representatives Edward Tiffin defeated Federalist candidates Benjamin I. Gilman, Arthur St. Clair and Bezaleel Wells.

zh.t: 1803年美国俄亥俄州首届州长选举
zh.s: 1803年1月11日，俄亥俄举行州长选举，为同年3月1日正式建州选出首任州长。民主共和党候选人、前西北领地众议院议长爱德华·蒂芬，击败联邦党候选人本杰明·I.吉尔曼、阿瑟·圣克莱尔及比撒列·韦尔斯。

en.s: The Battle of Hoogstraten was fought on 11 January 1814 between a French army, led by François Roguet, and a Russo-Prussian-British army, led by Friedrich Wilhelm Freiherr von Bülow. The battle, which ended in Bülow's victory, consisted of a series of engagements situated between Essen and Turnhout. The battle was named after Hoogstraten, the main town of the Kempen region.

zh.s: 1814年1月11日，弗朗索瓦·罗盖率领的法军与弗里德里希·威廉·冯·比洛男爵率领的俄、普、英联军交战，最终比洛获胜。战役由埃森与蒂尔瑙特之间的一系列交战组成，因肯彭地区的主要城镇霍赫斯特拉滕而得名。

en.s: On January 11, 1820, a conflagration affected the city of Savannah, Georgia, United States, burning down almost 500 buildings and causing roughly $4 million (equivalent to $92 million in 2025) in damages. It was the most severe fire in the city's history and one of the most damaging in the country at that time.

zh.s: 1820年1月11日，美国佐治亚州萨凡纳发生大火，近500栋建筑被毁，损失约400万美元，按原文采用的2025年币值换算约为9200万美元。这是萨凡纳历史上最严重的火灾，也是当时美国破坏最严重的火灾之一。

en.s: The Jintian Uprising was an armed revolt formally declared by Hong Xiuquan on 11 January 1851 during the late Qing Dynasty. The uprising was named after Jintian (present-day Guiping, Guangxi), the place where it took place. It was the beginning of the Taiping Rebellion.

zh.s: 1851年1月11日，清朝后期，洪秀全正式宣布发动武装起义。起义因发生于金田，即今广西桂平一带而得名，标志着太平天国运动开始。

en.s: The 1850–51 Massachusetts gubernatorial election consisted of an initial popular held on November 11, 1850 that was followed by a legislative vote that was conducted on January 11, 1851. It saw the election of Democratic Party nominee George S. Boutwell. The ultimate task of electing the governor had been placed before the Massachusetts General Court because no candidate received the majority of the vote required for a candidate to be elected through the popular election.
en.n: This entry records the legislative, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1850—1851年马萨诸塞州州长选举先于1850年11月11日举行普选，随后于1851年1月11日由州议会投票，民主党候选人乔治·S·鲍特韦尔最终当选。由于没有候选人在普选中获得法定过半数选票，选出州长的任务交由马萨诸塞州议会完成。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的州议会投票日期。

en.s: The Battle of Lucas Bend took place on January 11, 1862 near Lucas Bend, four miles north of Columbus on Mississippi River in Kentucky as it lay at the time of the American Civil War. In the network of the Mississippi, Tennessee and Ohio rivers, the Union river gunboats under Flag Officer Andrew Hull Foote and General Ulysses S. Grant sought to infiltrate and attack the Confederate positions in Tennessee. On the day of the battle, the Union ironclads Essex and St Louis, transporting troops down the Mississippi in fog, engaged the Confederate cotton clad warships General Polk, Ivy and Jackson towing the gun platform New Orleans at a curve known as Lucas Bend in Kentucky.

zh.s: 1862年1月11日，美国内战中的卢卡斯河湾战役，在肯塔基州密西西比河畔哥伦布以北四英里处展开。安德鲁·赫尔·富特海军将官与尤利西斯·S.格兰特将军，试图利用密西西比河、田纳西河及俄亥俄河水网，让联邦军炮艇深入并攻击邦联在田纳西的阵地。当天，联邦军铁甲舰“埃塞克斯”号和“圣路易斯”号在雾中沿密西西比河向下游运兵，在卢卡斯河湾与邦联以棉包防护的“波尔克将军”号、“常春藤”号及“杰克逊”号交战，后者当时正拖曳“新奥尔良”号炮台。

en.s: The Battle of Hartville was fought January 11, 1863, in Wright County, Missouri, as part of John S. Marmaduke's first expedition into Missouri, during the American Civil War.

zh.s: 1863年1月11日，美国内战中的哈特维尔战役在密苏里州赖特县展开，是约翰·S.马马杜克首次远征密苏里的组成部分。

en.t: End of the Battle of Arkansas Post
en.s: The Battle of Arkansas Post ended on 11 January 1863 during the American Civil War. Union forces under John McClernand and David Dixon Porter captured Fort Hindman after the battle of 9–11 January.

zh.t: 阿肯色波斯特战役结束
zh.s: 1863年1月11日，美国南北战争中的阿肯色波斯特战役结束。经过1月9日至11日的战斗，约翰·麦克勒南和戴维·迪克森·波特指挥的联邦军队攻占欣德曼堡。

en.s: The action off Galveston Light was a short naval battle fought during the American Civil War in January 1863. Confederate raider CSS Alabama encountered and sank the United States Navy steamer USS Hatteras off Galveston Lighthouse in Texas.

zh.t: 加尔维斯顿灯塔外海海战
zh.s: 1863年1月，美国南北战争期间，得克萨斯州加尔维斯顿灯塔外海发生一场短暂海战。邦联袭击舰“阿拉巴马号”遭遇美国海军蒸汽舰“哈特拉斯号”，并将其击沉。

en.s: The Battle of Lomaruguá was fought in January 1870, during the Paraguayan War's Campaign of the Hills. It was a Brazilian victory over some of Paraguayan president Francisco Solano López's last remaining forces; it was fought to the north of the Jejuí Guazú River. It was the last battle fought before the Battle of Cerro Corá in March of the same year, which ended the war.

zh.s: 洛马鲁瓜战役于1870年1月发生在巴拉圭战争的山地战役期间，地点位于热茹伊瓜苏河以北。巴西军队击败了巴拉圭总统弗朗西斯科·索拉诺·洛佩斯麾下最后一批残余部队中的一部。这也是同年3月塞罗科拉战役之前的最后一场战斗，巴拉圭战争随后在塞罗科拉结束。

en.s: The Anglo-Zulu War, or simply the Zulu War, was fought in present-day South Africa from January to early July 1879 between forces of the British Empire and the Zulu Kingdom. Two famous battles of the war were the Zulu victory at Isandlwana and the British defence at Rorke's Drift.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1879年1月至7月初，大英帝国军队与祖鲁王国军队在今南非境内交战，史称英祖战争。其中两场著名战斗分别是祖鲁军获胜的伊散德尔瓦纳战役，以及英军坚守阵地的罗克渡口战役。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The siege of Marabastad was a siege of Fort Marabastad, in present day Limpopo, South Africa, carried out by the Boer Republic of Transvaal, starting on 11 January 1881, and ending with British surrender on 2 April 1881. It took place during the First Boer War, during which Boer forces besieged several British garrisons across the country.

zh.s: 1881年1月11日，布尔人的德兰士瓦共和国开始围攻马拉巴斯塔德堡，地点位于今南非林波波省，最终英军于4月2日投降。这是第一次布尔战争的一部分，当时布尔军队正围攻当地多处英军驻地。

en.s: The Crawford affair was a battle fought between Mexico and the United States in January 1886 during the Geronimo Campaign. Captain Emmet Crawford was commanding a company of Apache scouts, sixty miles southeast of Nacori Chico in Sonora, when his camp was attacked by Mexican Army militiamen. In the action, Crawford was shot and later died; his death nearly started a war between the United States and Mexico.

zh.s: 1886年1月，杰罗尼莫战役期间，美墨双方发生克劳福德事件。埃米特·克劳福德上尉正率领一支阿帕奇侦察兵部队，驻扎在墨西哥索诺拉州纳科里奇科东南约60英里处，其营地遭墨西哥民兵袭击。克劳福德在交战中中弹，后来伤重不治，他的死亡几乎引发美墨战争。

en.t: 1905 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1905 United States Senate election in California was held on January 11, 1905, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Republican United States District Attorney Frank P. Flint was elected over Democratic Congressman Theodore A. Bell.

zh.t: 1905年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1905年1月11日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出该州第一组参议员席位的代表。共和党籍联邦地区检察官弗兰克·P.弗林特，击败民主党联邦众议员西奥多·A.贝尔当选。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1910 occurred on Tuesday, January 11, 1910. John F. Fitzgerald, who had been Mayor of Boston from 1906 to 1908, defeated incumbent George A. Hibbard and two other candidates. This was the first Boston mayoral election held under a new city charter, which made the election nonpartisan, and increased the mayor's term from two years to four years.

zh.s: 1910年1月11日星期二，波士顿举行市长选举。曾于1906至1908年担任市长的约翰·F.菲茨杰拉德，击败现任市长乔治·A.希巴德及另外两名候选人。这是新市宪章生效后的首次市长选举，改为非党派竞选，并将市长任期从两年延长至四年。

en.s: The Lawrence Textile Strike, also known as the Bread and Roses Strike, was a strike of immigrant workers in Lawrence, Massachusetts, in 1912 led by the Industrial Workers of the World (IWW). Prompted by a two-hour pay cut corresponding to a new law shortening the workweek for women, the strike spread rapidly through the town, growing to more than twenty thousand workers and involving nearly every mill in Lawrence.

zh.s: 1912年，美国马萨诸塞州劳伦斯的移民纺织工人在世界产业工人联盟领导下举行罢工，也称“面包与玫瑰”罢工。一项新法律缩短了女工每周工作时数，工厂随之扣减两小时工资，引发抗议。罢工迅速蔓延，参与者超过2万人，涉及劳伦斯几乎所有纺织厂。

en.t: In the treaty signed on 11 January 1913, Mongolia and Tibet declared mutual recognition and allegiance
en.s: A Treaty of friendship and alliance between the Government of Mongolia and Tibet was signed on 11 January 1913 (corresponding to 29 December 1912 of the Julian calendar), at Urga (now Ulaanbaatar). This treaty's text in Mongolian was published by the Mongolian Academy of Sciences in 1982, and in 2007 an original copy in Tibetan language and script surfaced from Mongolian archives.

zh.s: 1913年1月11日，即儒略历1912年12月29日，蒙古政府与西藏政府在库伦（今乌兰巴托）签署《友好同盟条约》。条约的蒙古文文本于1982年由蒙古科学院公布；2007年，蒙古档案中又出现了一份藏文原件。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Montenegro on 11 January 1914. The People's Party won with the platform of union with Serbia, whilst the governing True People's Party won just four elected seats. The Working Bloc coalition led by the People's Party, which won an absolute majority of votes, formed a parliamentary majority in alliance with the Mijušković Group and the Unified Serb Youth that held 44 seats.

zh.s: 1914年1月11日，黑山举行议会选举。人民党以与塞尔维亚合并为纲领赢得选举，执政的真正人民党只获得四个民选席位。人民党领导的“工作集团”联盟赢得绝对多数选票，并与米尤什科维奇集团及统一塞尔维亚青年组织结盟，组成拥有44席的议会多数。

en.s: The Battle of Ojinaga, also known as the Taking of Ojinaga, was one of the battles of the Mexican Revolution and was fought on January 11, 1914. The conflict put an end to the last stronghold of the Federal Army in Northern Mexico. After the rebel Generals Toribio Ortega Ramírez and Pánfilo Natera García could not finish the place off, Pancho Villa arrived in Ojinaga with a large army, thus displacing the forces of Salvador Mercado from the city.

zh.s: 1914年1月11日，墨西哥革命中的奥希纳加战役爆发，也称攻占奥希纳加，终结了联邦军在墨西哥北部的最后据点。起义军将领托里维奥·奥尔特加·拉米雷斯和潘菲洛·纳特拉·加西亚未能拿下该城，随后潘乔·比利亚率大军抵达，最终将萨尔瓦多·梅尔卡多的部队逐出城外。

en.s: The Karluk, a ship of the Canadian Arctic Expedition, sank on 11 January 1914 after being crushed by ice. Captain Robert Bartlett subsequently organised the survivors’ journey over the ice towards Wrangel Island.

zh.s: 1914年1月11日，加拿大北极考察队的“卡尔卢克号”被海冰挤压后沉没。此后，船长罗伯特·巴特利特组织幸存者徒步穿越冰面，向弗兰格尔岛进发。

en.s: The Third bombardment of Mount Lovćen was a military engagement between the joint armies of Austria-Hungary and German Empire against the Kingdom of Montenegro in January 1916. It was a part of the Montenegrin campaign during World War I. After the fighting between 7 and 11 January 1916, the Austro-Hungarians were able to capture heavily fortified positions on the top of Lovćen mountain massif and later enter into Cetinje, former capital of Montenegro.

zh.t: 第三次洛夫琴山炮击战
zh.s: 1916年1月，奥匈帝国和德意志帝国联军与黑山王国军队在洛夫琴山交战，这是第一次世界大战黑山战役的一部分。经过1月7日至11日的战斗，奥匈军队攻占了洛夫琴山顶设防严密的阵地，随后进入黑山旧都采蒂涅。

en.s: The Kingsland explosion was an incident that took place during World War I at a munitions factory in Lyndhurst, New Jersey, United States. An arbitration commission in 1931 determined that, "In the Kingsland Case the Commission finds upon the evidence that the fire was not caused by any German agent." The U.S. was officially neutral, but American and Canadian companies supplied goods to the Allies giving an incentive for acts of sabotage on American soil. The acts were largely symbolic rather than having any real effect on the war supply efforts and only two acts were of even marginal importance, given the scale of the conflict.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，美国新泽西州林德赫斯特的一家军火工厂发生金斯兰爆炸事件。1931年，一个仲裁委员会依据证据认定：“金斯兰案中的火灾并非德国特工所为。”当时美国官方仍保持中立，但美加企业向协约国供应物资，因此美国境内存在遭破坏的动机。不过，这类破坏大多具有象征意义，实际并未显著影响战争物资供应；相对于战争规模，仅有两起事件勉强具有一定重要性。

en.s: The 1918 Ekaterinoslav uprising (Ukrainian: Катеринославське збройне повстання) was a Bolshevik-led uprising in Ekaterinoslav (modern Dnipro) on 9–11 January 1918 that later was supported by Red Guards of the Soviet expeditionary group under the command of Pavel Yegorov, and grew into an open intervention into Ukrainian internal affairs and the war against the Central Council of Ukraine.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 叶卡捷琳诺斯拉夫布尔什维克起义
zh.s: 1918年1月9日至11日，布尔什维克领导的起义在叶卡捷琳诺斯拉夫（今第聂伯罗）发生。起义后来得到帕维尔·叶戈罗夫指挥的苏俄远征部队红卫兵支持，演变为对乌克兰内政的公开干涉，以及针对乌克兰中央拉达的战争。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The First Battle of İnönü (Turkish: Birinci İnönü Muharebesi) took place between 6 and 11 January 1921 near İnönü in Hüdavendigâr Vilayet (present-day Eskişehir Province, Turkey) during the Greco-Turkish War (1919–22), also known as the western front of the larger Turkish War of Independence. en.s: The occupation of the Ruhr (German: Ruhrbesetzung) was the period from 11 January 1923 to 25 August 1925 when French and Belgian troops occupied the Ruhr region of Germany. The occupation of the heavily industrialized Ruhr district came in response to Germany's repeated defaults on the reparations payments required under the terms of the Treaty of Versailles.

en.s: Operation Excess was a series of British supply convoys to Malta, Alexandria and Greece in January 1941. The operation was the first to encounter Luftwaffe anti-shipping aircraft over the Mediterranean Sea and all the convoyed freighters reached their destinations. The destroyer Gallant was disabled by Italian mines and Axis bombers severely damaged the cruiser Southampton and the aircraft carrier Illustrious.

en.s: The capture of Klisura Pass (Greek: Κατάληψη της Κλεισούρας) was a military operation that took place during 6–11 January 1941 in southern Albania, and was one of the most important battles of the Greco-Italian War. The Italian Army, initially deployed on the Greek-Albanian border, launched a major offensive against Greece on 28 October 1940. After a two-week conflict, Greece managed to repel the invading Italians in the battles of Pindus and Elaia–Kalamas.

en.s: The Battle of Tarakan took place on 11–12 January 1942, a day after the Empire of Japan declared war on the Kingdom of the Netherlands. Although Tarakan was only a small marshy island off northeastern Borneo in the Netherlands East Indies (today's Indonesia), its 700 oil wells, refineries, and airfield made it a crucial objective for Japan in the Pacific War.

zh.s: 1942年1月11日至12日，日本向荷兰宣战后一天，打拉根战役爆发。打拉根是荷属东印度，今印度尼西亚，婆罗洲东北近海的一座沼泽小岛，但岛上的700口油井、炼油厂及机场，使其成为日本在太平洋战争中的重要目标。

en.t: Sino-British Treaty for the Relinquishment of Extra-Territorial Rights in China
en.s: The Sino-British Treaty for the Relinquishment of Extra-Territorial Rights in China, or the Sino-British New Equal Treaty, was a bilateral treaty concluded between the British and the Chinese government in Chongqing on 11 January 1943. The formal name of the treaty was Treaty Between His Majesty in Respect of the United Kingdom and India and His Excellency the President of the National Government of the Republic of China for the Relinquishment of Extra-Territorial Rights in China and the Regulation of Related Matters. Under that treaty, the British government relinquished any special rights it had in China.

zh.t: 《中英新约》签订，英国放弃在华治外法权
zh.s: 1943年1月11日，英国与中国政府在重庆签订放弃英国在华治外法权的双边条约，通常称《中英新约》或《中英平等新约》。其正式名称为《中华民国与联合王国关于取消英国在华治外法权及处理有关特权条约》，英方缔约名义涵盖英国与印度。根据条约，英国政府放弃其在中国享有的各项特权。

en.t: Treaty between the United States and China for the Relinquishment of Extraterritorial Rights in China
en.s: The Treaty between the United States and China for the Relinquishment of Extraterritorial Rights in China was a bilateral treaty signed by the United States and the Republic of China on January 11, 1943. The formal name of the treaty was Treaty Between the United States of America and the Republic of China for the Relinquishment of Extraterritorial Rights in China and the Regulation of Related Matters. It became effective on May 20, 1943, following the mutual exchange of ratifications pursuant to Article VIII.

en.s: The Action of 11 January 1944 was a minor naval action that resulted in the sinking of the light cruiser Kuma of the Imperial Japanese Navy by the British Royal Navy submarine HMS Tally-Ho. Kuma was being escorted by the destroyer Uranami about 10 nmi (12 mi; 19 km) north-west of Penang, Malaya. Tally-Ho was patrolling from her base at Trincomalee, Ceylon searching for Japanese vessels and on 9 January, sighted the Japanese light cruiser Kuma off Penang. Kuma was on anti-submarine warfare exercises. She was flanked by destroyers and Tally-Ho could not get within range.

zh.s: 1944年1月11日，英国皇家海军潜艇“塔利霍”号击沉日本海军轻巡洋舰“球磨”号。“球磨”号当时由驱逐舰“浦波”号护航，位于马来亚槟城西北约十海里、即19公里处。“塔利霍”号从锡兰亭可马里基地出发巡逻、搜索日舰，1月9日已在槟城外海发现“球磨”号。但该舰当时正在进行反潜演练，侧翼有驱逐舰保护，“塔利霍”号无法进入攻击距离。

en.s: The Afghan tribal revolts of 1944–1947 or the Khost disturbances were a series of tribal revolts in the Kingdom of Afghanistan by Zadran, Safi and Mangal tribesmen which lasted from February 1944 to January 1947. The causes of the revolts lay in the worsening conditions of farmers, changes in conscription laws, the elimination of the power of Safi tribal leaders, Amanullah loyalism, trading monopolies, government surveillance, taxation, and poverty.

en.s: African Convention (French: Convention Africaine) was a political party in French West Africa. The CA was formed at a meeting in Dakar on 11 January 1957. The CA constisted of the Senegalese Popular Bloc (BPS) of Léopold Sédar Senghor, the African Popular Movement of Nazi Boni in Upper Volta and the Nigerien Democratic Front (FDN) of Zodi Ikhia in Niger. In the 1957 territorial assembly elections, CA member parties won 96 seats. CA won in Senegal, and gained presence in three other assemblies. In March 1958 the African Convention and the African Socialist Movement (MSA) merged to form the African Regroupment Party (PRA).

zh.s: 1957年1月11日，法属西非政党非洲公约党在达喀尔的一次会议上成立。成员包括利奥波德·塞达尔·桑戈尔领导的塞内加尔人民集团、纳齐·博尼在上沃尔特领导的非洲人民运动，以及佐迪·伊基亚在尼日尔领导的尼日尔民主阵线。在1957年领地议会选举中，成员党共赢得96席，在塞内加尔获胜，并进入另外三个议会。1958年3月，非洲公约党与非洲社会主义运动合并，组成非洲重组党。

en.s: Lufthansa Flight 502 was a scheduled flight from Hamburg, Germany to Buenos Aires, Argentina on 11 January 1959. The flight was being operated by a Lockheed L-1049G Super Constellation (registration D-ALAK). On the leg between Senegal and Brazil the Super Constellation was on approach to Rio de Janeiro–Galeão International Airport when it crashed near Flecheiras Beach just short of the runway.

en.t: Throgs Neck Bridge over the East River, linking New York City's boroughs of The Bronx and Queens, opens to road traffic
en.s: The Throgs Neck Bridge is a suspension bridge in New York City, carrying six lanes of Interstate 295 (I-295) over the East River where it meets the Long Island Sound. The bridge connects the Throggs Neck section of the Bronx with the Bay Terrace section of Queens. Opened on January 11, 1961, it is the newest bridge across the East River and was built to relieve traffic on the Bronx–Whitestone Bridge, 2 miles (3.2 km) to the west.

zh.t: 纽约斯罗格斯颈大桥通车
zh.s: 斯罗格斯颈大桥是纽约市的一座悬索桥，在东河与长岛海湾交汇处承载295号州际公路的6条车道，连接布朗克斯区斯罗格斯颈与皇后区贝赛德露台。大桥于1961年1月11日通车，是东河上最新建成的一座桥，修建目的是缓解西侧2英里（3.2公里）外布朗克斯—白石大桥的交通压力。

en.s: The 1967–68 Durand Cup final was the 63rd final of the Durand Cup, the oldest football competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giant East Bengal and Bengal Nagpur Railway on 11 January 1968 at the Corporation Stadium in New Delhi. East Bengal won the final 1–0 to claim their 5th Durand Cup title. Mohammed Habib scored the only goal in the final as East Bengal lifted their fifth Durand Cup title.

zh.s: 1968年1月11日，第63届杜兰德杯决赛在印度新德里的市政体育场举行，由加尔各答劲旅东孟加拉对阵孟加拉—那格浦尔铁路队。杜兰德杯是印度历史最悠久的足球赛事。穆罕默德·哈比卜打进唯一进球，帮助东孟加拉以1比0获胜，第五次夺冠。

en.s: United Airlines Flight 2885 was a scheduled cargo flight from Cleveland to Los Angeles, with stopover in Detroit. On January 11, 1983, a DC-8 operating as Flight 2885 crashed after take-off from Detroit, killing all three crew members. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) investigation determined that the cause for the crash was pilot error. A radioactive package was found on board, but no radioactive material was spilled.

zh.s: 联合航空2885号班机是一班从克利夫兰飞往洛杉矶、经停底特律的定期货运航班。1983年1月11日，执飞这班航班的DC-8飞机在底特律起飞后坠毁，3名机组人员全部遇难。美国国家运输安全委员会调查认定，事故由驾驶员操作失误造成。机上发现一件放射性物品包裹，但没有发生放射性物质泄漏。

en.s: The Algerian Civil War (Arabic: الحرب الأهلية الجزائرية, romanized: al-Ḥarb al-Ahlīyah al-Jazāʼirīyah), known in Algeria as the Black Decade (Arabic: العشرية السوداء, romanized: al-ʻAshrīyah al-Sawdāʼ; French: La décennie noire), was a civil war fought between the Algerian government and various Islamist rebel groups from 11 January 1992 (following a coup negating an Islamist electoral victory) to 8 February 2002.

en.s: The 1992 Algerian coup d'état took place on 11 January 1992. Concerned by the FIS (Islamic Salvation Front) victory in the first round of the 1991 parliamentary election, the army took action and cancelled the electoral process to prevent the forming of an Islamic state in Algeria. The army forced president Chadli Bendjedid to resign and brought in the exiled Mohamed Boudiaf to serve as the new president.

en.s: The Sidi-Hamed massacre took place on the night of January 11, 1998 (the last day of Ramadan), in the town of Sidi-Hamed (or Sidi-Hammad), 30 km south of Algiers. An estimated fifty gunmen poured in, attacking children and adults alike; they bombed a cafe where films were being watched and a mosque in nearby Haouche Sahraoui, killing those who fled, and stormed houses to slaughter those within. According to official figures, 103 were killed and seventy injured, including two pro-government fighters and five of the attackers. Other sources indicate a higher toll; AFP supposedly counted over 120 corpses, and some Algerian newspapers claimed 400.

zh.s: 1998年1月11日晚，斋月的最后一天，阿尔及尔以南30公里的西迪哈梅德镇发生屠杀。约50名枪手涌入，不分成人儿童发动攻击；他们炸毁一间正在放电影的咖啡馆，以及附近Haouche Sahraoui的一座清真寺，杀害逃跑者，并闯入住宅屠杀居民。官方数据显示，103人死亡、70人受伤，其中包括两名亲政府武装人员及五名袭击者。其他资料给出的死亡人数更高：据称法新社清点到120多具遗体，一些阿尔及利亚报纸则称有400人死亡。

en.s: The ninth gubernatorial election for the city of Bangkok, Thailand was held on the 11 January 2009.
